# Alcantara Safety Solutions

> Alcantara Safety Solutions is a safety plan coordination practice founded and led by Karen Alcantara, CRSP (Canadian Registered Safety Professional) and NCSO (National Construction Safety Officer). The company designs custom workplace safety plans, safe work procedures, hazard and risk assessments, safety manuals, orientation packages, and contractor safety packages — and runs compliance reviews against OSHA and WorkSafeBC regulations for businesses across North America. Positioning: helps companies win contracts, pass inspections, reduce liability, and protect their people.

## Company Facts

- Founder: Karen Alcantara, CRSP, NCSO (12+ years of experience, 500+ custom safety plans delivered)
- Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada — serving businesses across Canada and the United States
- Contact: (604) 555-0142, karen@alcantarasafety.com, Monday–Friday 8:00am–6:00pm (typical response within one business day)
- Credentials: OSHA compliant, WorkSafeBC certified, COR-ready documentation, fully insured
- First-time inspection pass rate: 98%

## Services & Pricing

- Custom Safety Plans: $2,500–$7,500, completed in 4–8 weeks (rush delivery in as little as 5 business days). Full hazard assessment, safe work procedures, training matrices, emergency protocols, PPE program, inspection-ready documentation, post-implementation audit. https://www.alcantarasafety.com/services/safety-plan-creation.html
- Compliance Reviews / Consulting: $1,500–$5,000. Regulation-by-regulation gap analysis (OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1926, WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation), documentation audit, mock inspection, prioritized corrective action plan, citation response support. https://www.alcantarasafety.com/services/compliance-consulting.html
- Hazard & Risk Assessments: $1,200–$4,000. One to two days on site. Scored risk register, photo-documented findings, worker interviews, controls ranked by the hierarchy of controls. https://www.alcantarasafety.com/services/risk-assessments.html
- Safe Work Procedures: plain-language, step-by-step procedures for high-risk tasks.
- Safety Manuals & Orientation Packages: complete health and safety manuals plus new-hire onboarding packages.
- Contractor Safety Packages: COR-ready documentation and pre-qualification packages to satisfy clients before work begins.
- Ongoing Safety Coordination: monthly support, annual reviews, plan updates, refresher training.
- Services hub: https://www.alcantarasafety.com/services.html

2. Needs assessment: industry, employees, equipment, risks, compliance requirements
3. Custom plan build — never copied from templates
4. Review together — every section explained
5. Stay protected — updates as the business grows and regulations change

## WorkSafeBC Alignment

All safety plans are built around WorkSafeBC's published guidance for developing a health and safety program: signed health and safety policy, regular workplace inspections, written safe work procedures for high-risk tasks, worker orientation, education and training, joint committee or worker health and safety representative, incident investigations (including immediate reporting of serious incidents), record-keeping (program reviews, orientation records, inspection reports, meeting records, investigation reports, first aid records), and an annual program review against the OHS Regulation.
